exposure: fetoscopic laser surgery (FLS) for twin-to-twin transfusion syndrome (TTTS)
cohort: The study included 637 mothers treated with fetoscopic laser surgery for twin-to-twin transfusion syndrome at the Leiden University Medical Center between 2008 and 2021.
finding: The rate of severe maternal complications (grade 3 or 4) after fetoscopic laser surgery for TTTS was 8.0%.
followup_time: Up to and including delivery and the third stage of labor, with mention of postpartum hemorrhage.
